note: Cooked food (Items refill 11): a roast keeps for cooked_life_mult times what the raw item had left (Tyler: 1.5 to 2.5 times, 3 at most), never more than the roast's own shelf life (spoilage.json), and a hot meal or drink adds the warms points to body warmth when eaten. raw_sick: eating these uncooked still feeds you but makes you sick for that many game hours (by item id or id suffix; raw meat 24, fiddleheads and beans 12, acorns and wild mushrooms a mild 6). Cooking placeholder (until the cook and food systems exist): at a lit fire, one raw forage item becomes Roasted forage (cooks_into maps others). A gathered item cooks when its id ends with one of the cookable words. Fire store (Dave 2026-10-22, F beside a fire): fire_slots slots for wood and food; wood in it feeds the fire when burn_left falls under feed_below_s seconds (or loads a cold fire), and one raw item cooks every box_cook_s seconds while it burns.
fuel_note: Burn times in GAME seconds (clock is 24:1; a game hour is 2.5 real minutes), Dave 24 Oct: a stick, driftwood piece or bundle of kindling is a small fire's wood (stick 15 game minutes, driftwood 15, kindling 7.5), firewood 1 game hour (soft firewood 30 minutes), a log 2 game hours. A fire placed from a kit is laid with 4 sticks and lit by hand with plant fibre.
fire_tiers_note: Dave 24 Oct: one campfire whose size follows its wood. The fire burns its biggest wood first. A tier needs at least min_pieces pieces of that wood; once burning it stays that size until that wood is gone, then drops to the highest tier that still has min_pieces, else the survival fire. Tier 1 survival (sticks, driftwood, kindling), 2 campfire (firewood), 3 bonfire (logs). state is the world-item state of a lit fire of that tier (1 stays the campfire; 40 and 41 are new and only appended). light_m and light_energy size the client light, heat_c and heat_radius_m the warmth.

rain_light_chance.note: Lighting a fire in light rain (under puts_out strength) can fail: chance = max(min_chance, 1 - rain / puts_out x loss). The tinder is used either way.
